decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><ul><li>Site Location and Block Plan - drawing no.&nbsp;25/107/001 - dated 4th June 2025</li><li>Proposed Plans and Elevations - drawing no.&nbsp;25/107/003 - dated 4th June 2025</li></ul><p>No other drawings or documents apply.</p>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing dwellinghouse.
